source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check  fan sensor can detect change on fan
1.Enter BMC Web UI
2.Remove FAN1

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1.Check FAN1 sensor  presented on here
2. Make sure sensors can present on here during trigegr critical event

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sensor list 2>&1 | grep -iE "fan|FAN" ; echo ---sel---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sel list last 20 2>&1 | grep -iE "fan|threshold"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL ipmitool fan sensor list + SEL fan/threshold entries so the user verifies the critical-fan sensor threshold and whether a critical fan event occurred.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: this reads current fan sensor/threshold state; the actual fan-critical event injection is physical and done by the operator - agent only reports BMC readings.

original_test_intent: Verify FAN1 is represented in the BMC sensor view and that removing FAN1 through the approved hardware procedure causes the expected critical sensor/event response.
original_method: A qualified operator confirms FAN1 in BMC Web UI, physically removes the mapped fan under the platform hot-swap or powered-off procedure, observes the Web UI critical state, and reinstalls/restores FAN1 while automated tools collect full sensor, thermal and SEL evidence.
manual_activity: The source explicitly requires entering BMC Web UI and physically removing FAN1. A qualified operator must perform the removal/reinstallation and inspect the GUI state; automated IPMI evidence supports but cannot replace those core actions.
required_inputs: Exact FAN1 physical slot to BMC sensor/Web UI mapping
Platform approval for powered hot-swap or required power-off sequence
Expected critical state, event text/severity, response timeout and clear behavior
Temperature/RPM abort limits, replacement/recovery path, operator and maintenance approval
safety_requirements: Do not remove FAN1 while powered unless exact platform documentation approves hot-swap for the current load/state.
Continuously monitor remaining fans, temperatures, alarms, host and OOB reachability.
Stop and restore cooling on threshold approach, loss of redundancy, unexpected fault or management loss.
Preserve Web UI, sensor and SEL evidence; do not use filtered grep alone, and do not repeat removal automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete pre/during/post fan sensors, RPM, temperatures, thresholds and SEL/event data.
Correlate the operator's physical action and Web UI capture with the critical event timestamp.
Verify restoration telemetry and report evidence without claiming the manual steps or formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform/supervise FAN1 removal and reinstallation.
Inspect/capture the BMC Web UI sensor state and provide the event specification.
Confirm cooling recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful only as supporting evidence. Its grep filters can omit context and cannot establish the physical removal or Web UI criterion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the manual Web UI/removal method and collect full, unfiltered `sensor`/`sdr elist` plus SEL exports using the approved interface; the linked fan-control script does not replace removal.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FAN1, BMC Web UI, physical removal, critical response and both one-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN PHYSICAL EVENT WITH SYNCHRONIZED TELEMETRY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a timestamped operator checklist for GUI baseline, physical removal and replacement while a monitor continuously records mapped FAN1 status, all fan RPMs, temperatures and SEL state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact chassis/fan module and BMC firmware with documented FAN1 hot-swap behavior.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record fan FRU, chassis, BMC, CPLD and monitoring-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform fan service/hot-swap documentation and BMC sensor/event specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds mapping, continuous safeguards and deterministic recovery without replacing physical removal or GUI observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; CLI telemetry is corroboration and does not substitute for source-required Web UI evidence.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Fan map, event rule, hot-swap method and limits.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Removing a non-hot-swappable or sole cooling fan may force shutdown or damage; execution remains gated by platform procedure.

project_override_considerations: A project may require powered hot-swap or an approved powered-off insertion/removal method and define event timing. It must disclose any deviation. Missing project details affect readiness, while the physical/GUI core still makes the case MANUAL ONLY.
expected_evidence: Platform/FAN1 map, hot-swap/power procedure, event criteria and approval
Timestamped BMC Web UI baseline/critical/restored captures
Full fan/RPM/temperature/threshold/SEL timeline and restored health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Despite grammatical defects, procedure and criteria consistently require FAN1 presence and a sensor response during the removal-triggered critical event.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Hot-swap support, event details and recovery are readiness inputs. When supplied, a qualified operator can execute the manual core safely; it is not permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retain its read-only evidence role but reject CLI output as a substitute for physical removal and Web UI observation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain hot-swap, monitoring and recovery controls; change capability to MANUAL ONLY under the V3.1 physical/GUI core rule.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly distinguishes human event injection/GUI acceptance from automatable evidence collection.

review_improvement: Restores the two source-required human actions and prevents a read-only sensor query from falsely claiming completion of the critical-event case.
independent_technical_reasoning: The test is not merely a sensor read. Its stimulus is removal of a named physical fan and one required view is BMC Web UI. Both are core to demonstrating the event path; therefore MANUAL ONLY is correct even though telemetry collection can be automated.

no_automatic_retry: Remove FAN1 at most once under the approved plan. On any thermal, event, GUI, sensor or recovery anomaly, restore cooling and preserve the result; do not repeat removal automatically.
